summary: Fresh build, first testing iteration. Full backend + frontend testing done. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (health, POST /api/scans with & without faults, GET list sorted desc + no _id leakage, GET by id incl. 404, DELETE incl. 404). Frontend: end-to-end mobile flows all working (Connect success -> Dashboard -> Scan -> Send result -> History -> Detail -> Delete) and Error path via demo-unplug-switch shows troubleshooting error-card + retry-button. No blocking issues found. Only warnings: (1) native animation warning on web (expected - useNativeDriver falls back in web preview), (2) 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (RN internal / library-level, not blocking).

minor.issue: Returns 200 on create; conventional REST would use 201, but consistent with existing FastAPI response_model. Non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Emitted by Radar rings and progress bar. Harmless on web preview; still animates via JS. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:46-48 and /app/frontend/app/fault-codes.tsx:89-94
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from third-party (expo-linear-gradient / expo-image) internals. No user impact but should be tracked.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress or resolve the pointerEvents deprecation warning by updating any custom components that still pass pointerEvents as a prop instead of via style.
(Optional) For pure web-target animations, consider setting useNativeDriver:false explicitly to silence the warning, or gate with Platform.OS !== 'web'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection {"_id": 0} in list and get endpoints — good.
Env-driven config used everywhere (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). No hardcoding.
All interactive elements have kebab-case testIDs as specified. Excellent coverage.
Fault code randomness is fine; both branches (faults / no-faults) rendered correctly in tests.
generateVehicle/generateFaults not shown but exercised via context — worked as expected.
seed_data_creation: Test scans prefixed with TEST_VIN1234567890 were created and cleaned up in teardown_module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses uuid id (not _id). Frontend flows: /(Connect) -> /(tabs)/dashboard -> /fault-codes -> /(tabs)/history -> /scan/[id]. To test error path enable [data-testid=demo-unplug-switch]. Faults are ~25% empty (random) - handle both faults-summary & no-faults-view. All test IDs are kebab-case exactly as in review request.
